{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the data types and missing values
df_info = trial_df.info()
df_shape = trial_df.shape

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Display summary statistics
summary_stats = trial_df.describe(include='all')

# Return all observations
print('Shape:', df_shape)
print('\nMissing values:\n', missing_values)
print('\nDuplicates:', duplicates)
print('\nSummary statistics:\n', summary_stats)"}
